description: The file contains the PHP source code for the Pickup class, which extends a system engine model and implements functionality related to shipping pickup options in the OpenCart framework. It includes methods such as getQuote to generate shipping quotes based on configuration and address details.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: A class responsible for handling pickup shipping options, extending the core system model and implementing the getQuote method to provide shipping cost estimates.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Generates a shipping quote for the pickup method based on the provided address, configuration settings, and geo zones.
